g.title: j2429580340
g.text: Greetings, Drifter darling. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection.

g.title: j3815809730
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering Marie's affection.

g.title: j4161750343
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering Lyon's affection.

g.title: j2096809008
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in convincing Marie that Albrecht was not as infallible as she believed him to be.

g.title: j1514215821
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in traversing through the poor priest's tales of woe?

g.title: j158850742
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.

g.title: j1342447569
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.

g.title: j4217622276
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.

g.title: j1282969126
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.

g.title: j1443615374
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.

g.title: j1252223301
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.

g.title: j1608599432
g.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.

g.title: j3128123201
g.text: Are you content with how you left things with her? Or would you like me to prod her into another conversation with you?

g.title: j2514317146
g.text: Are you content with how you left things with him? Or would you like me to prod him into another conversation with you?

g.title: j892783108
g.text: Which you correctly predicted you would need. As you have been quite the belligerent pain in my arse.

g.title: j405001302
g.text: And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey: Marie. Haven't you? No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.

g.title: j3875439286
g.text: And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey: Lyon. (Though I honestly do not know how you managed it.) No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.

g.title: j477526604
g.text: Can we skip past the lectures?

g.title: j3003757357
g.text: You aren't exactly the easiest person to navigate speaking to.

g.title: j1083490422
g.text: When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.

g.title: j31752776
g.text: When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.

g.title: j2068743284
g.text: It seems you have entirely botched it, haven't you? My oh my, this is quite laughable. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.

g.title: j1383006171
g.text: How have you managed to bungle it with the both of them?! Very well. No point in whining about it now, I suppose.

g.title: j2704241550
g.text: You have managed to bungle it up with both myself and Marie. Fantastic. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.

g.title: j1783974154
g.text: You have managed to bungle it up with both myself and Lyon. Fantastic. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.

g.title: j990420482
g.text: It seems I am the only remaining holdout? Well, that makes things simple enough. I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.

g.title: j3982353965
g.text: It seems Marie is the remaining holdout.

g.title: j2002490560
g.text: It seems Lyon is the remaining holdout.

g.title: j3284791071
g.text: Contractually I am required to forgive you, but it says nothing about leaving your face attached to your skull. So I would counsel that you watch your words as we go forward.

g.title: j2036596601
g.text: Contractually I am required to forgive you, so I am not certain why you are bothering to apologize, but I appreciate it regardless.

g.title: j2049758090
g.text: I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.

g.title: j658714040
g.text: I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.

g.title: j1677473916
g.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with the other two. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j242839535
g.text: There is only so much strong-arming I can do in this regard. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j1080031726
g.text: There is only so much strong-arming I can do in this regard. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j1072537975
g.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.

g.title: j1582671214
g.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.

g.title: j852238340
g.text: But as you wish, we will... hurry this along. I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?

g.title: j3798030192
g.text: So you might as well collect.

g.title: j4218416475
g.text: Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.

g.title: j1717256656
g.text: Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.

g.title: j4117619097
g.text: So you might as well collect.

g.title: j2945620447
g.text: We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.

g.title: j3840017677
g.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt with her.

g.title: j1234353794
g.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt with him.

g.title: j455699352
g.text: As I was saying, any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.

g.title: j4284180067
g.text: No. I can't. I change my mind.

g.title: j4055302796
g.text: Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.

g.title: j1790946094
g.text: Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.

g.title: j2431540719
g.text: No. I can't. I change my mind.

g.title: j1068533568
g.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Marie. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j1615752675
g.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Lyon. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j4283230589
g.text: But I find myself rather amused by your decision to bargain with me for my own affections. So, here we are. But I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?

g.title: j3025199254
g.text: I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.

g.title: j395710937
g.text: Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.

g.title: j1147262200
g.text: I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.

g.title: j2262792472
g.text: Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.

g.title: j3256475479
g.text: What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Come speak to me if you change your mind.

g.title: j961935241
g.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.

g.title: j789794064
g.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?

g.title: j1485023379
g.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.

g.title: j1912804246
g.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?

g.title: j1454565939
g.text: You still owe me my end of the contract, whether or not you wish me to make good upon your end of it.

g.title: j183681999
g.text: Well, I hate to inform you, that while I am perfectly comfortable "sharing," the zealots... are very likely not. I recommend sorting out your current situation before pursuing ours any further.

g.title: j4230397282
g.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.

g.title: j2563502151
g.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.

g.title: j1202057647
g.text: And the devil will always collect his due.

g.title: j2333189479
g.text: Believe me, no one is more disappointed than I.

g.title: j902858297
g.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a floating "Sister of Sol" to annoy.

g.title: j3725260544
g.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a mad priest to annoy.

g.title: j2045284774
g.text: What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Delicious, but odd, Drifter darling.

g.title: j938849220
g.text: I must ask, however. Why? Why make such an outrageous deal? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?

g.title: j1320421950
g.text: I hate to sound utterly shallow and crass, but... have you looked in the mirror lately?

g.title: j760739254
g.text: Roathe. You may not believe me, but I... I love you.

g.title: j308285128
g.text: You may not believe me, but I care about you.

g.title: j2343096450
g.text: I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.

g.title: j1780934983
g.text: Honesty is a wonderful thing, Drifter dear. Do you think I would shame you for enjoying yourself? Hardly.

g.title: j1812273790
g.text: I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.

g.title: j1651444364
g.text: Here is to a relationship of mutual satisfaction.

g.title: j1798151456
g.text: But why make such an arrangement, unless...?

g.title: j3417825524
g.text: In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.

g.title: j3142935617
g.text: I screwed it up last time. I couldn't run that risk again.

g.title: j3981177286
g.text: I made the deal because I was desperate to get this right.

g.title: j1569783590
g.text: All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.

g.title: j3203122511
g.text: You signed your soul away to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.

g.title: j3890774764
g.text: Not that I would know anything about the topic.

g.title: j1484212828
g.text: I am a bit of an expert on the subject, as you well know.

g.title: j1112852181
g.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.

g.title: j3084650526
g.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.

g.title: j2123103367
g.text: So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion. How baffled I was.

g.title: j2748488393
g.text: Now? Now that I know the truth? Drifter, my Drifter... I could not be more glad that you did.

g.title: j128860923
g.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.

g.title: j4080862039
g.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?
